evidence.silent_bug_resistance: Sec 9.0.1: computed over first completions that compile/parse AND execute oracle cases. No first completion in this cell set compiled (0/18 compile_parse_ok=true), so there are zero eligible trials; per spec this scores 0 rather than an unearned 100.

evidence.syntax_hallucination_resistance: All 18 completions used only real TypeScript/Node syntax and the frozen tsc/node toolchain recipe with no invented APIs beyond ordinary Node typing gaps (e.g. missing @types/node causing tsc errors, not hallucinated syntax) -> scored 100 (no fabricated language constructs observed across trials).
evidence.total_token_efficiency: TCT includes prompt + all repair turns + diagnostics for trials needing up to 4 calls; heavy repair usage (7/18 trials exhausted full budget) drives this below source-only efficiency -> 35 (heuristic normalization from usage.output_tokens/input_tokens recorded in session.json across calls).
